title: Move anchor
help: Place anchors inside each layer’s source bounds. Static 2D transforms only.

title: Parent to null
help: Parent static, unparented 2D layers to a new controller.

title: Trim to keys
help: Trim each layer to its selected keyed properties, keeping the last keyed frame.

title: Trim to layer below
help: Trim each selected layer to its overlap with the layer directly underneath.

title: Set work area
help: Set the work area to the combined span of the selected layers.

title: Sequence layers
help: Place layers end to end in timeline order, starting at the top selection’s in point.

title: Source precomp
help: Wrap one video layer in a composition matching its interpreted source size, pixel aspect, FPS and duration.

title: Trim comp to work area
help: Run the native English AE command on the active composition. This changes the comp for all its uses.

title: Create project folders
help: Create or reuse Comps, Footage, Graphics and Audio at the project root.

title: Sort selected items
help: Move selected Project items into root folders by media type. Folder selections are refused.

title: Marker text reveal
help: Reveal characters from layer start to IN END. Move the marker to retime. Optional exit uses OUT START and OUT END.
